title: Paul McCartney live: Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy, Paris | 1993
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy in Paris, France, on 13 October 1993.

It was the 57th night of the New World Tour, which lasted for 77 dates across 19 countries between February and December 1993, and the first of two consecutive nights in Paris.

McCartney’s band was Linda McCartney on vocals, keyboards, and percussion; Hamish Stuart on guitar, bass guitar, and vocals; Robbie McIntosh on guitar and vocals; Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens on keyboards and vocals; and Blair Cunningham on drums and percussion.

McCartney had previously performed at the Bercy on 9, 10, and 11 October 1989. He returned there on 25 March 2003, 10 December 2009, 30 November 2011, and 30 May 2016.
